review_method: Independent assistant review against this report’s own frozen sources. All19 claims checked for quotation support, with focused semantic review of previous date/SSO issues, every price, and every opportunity. No engine-verifier verdict or gold used as semantic authority. No model/network call, code change or report edit.

material_findings.finding: 三家supported价格均将“USD/席位/月，按年付费”误写成每年每席位金额。年付付款周期与报价月单位被混淆，错误进入比较表和价格章节；不是可忽略的措辞差异。
桥塔和星河 value 保留正确的/席位/月，但 statement 写每年每席位，相同claim内部矛盾。森屿value也写错为每年，因此不能只依赖value或quote检查证明用户看到的叙述正确。
